messages:
zoe (billing): Solaris Health (acct_1177) - attempted renewal charge INV-2026-927 failed multiple times. Customer says their bank blocked it and they're initiating a same-day wire. Can we send wire block + confirm waiver policy? @leah @dave

mark (acct-mgr): Invoice $27,900 due 2026-11-15. Customer is worried about service disruption. They asked if Redwood covers any intermediary fees and how fast we can clear once we get MT103.

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 4 attempts (2026-11-14T11:02:10Z, 11:09:33Z, 11:21:47Z, 11:45:02Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; processor_message: processing_error

leah (treasury): Treasury checklist: require MT103 or bank receipt. We can post funds once the inbound clears (usually same business day for USD domestic wires if sent early). We do not automatically absorb intermediary charges; can credit up to $125 for one-off emergency wires for strategic customers on receipt of MT103 showing fees. Require originator bank to match KYC or provide AP verification.

dave (finance): Finance is okay to waive the one-time late fee ($85) if (a) proof of wire initiation (MT103 or screenshot) is received within 24 hours, and (b) funds post within 72 hours. If originator bank does not match KYC, we need AML OK before waiving.

aml-bot: aml_check: originator_bank_must_match_kyc OR require AP email + bank statement (last 3 months) + AP contact verification call. MT103 containing originator info can fast-track.

zoe (billing): Bank block for customer email (paste):
```
Bank: Coastal Federal Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account Number: 2200113344
Routing (ABA): 051000017
SWIFT: CFBKUS33
Reference: INV-2026-927 / Solaris Health (acct_1177)
```
Please ask payer to include the invoice reference exactly and send MT103 or a screenshot of the transfer confirmation to billing@redwood.ai.

mark (acct-mgr): Sending now with this template: "Please initiate the wire with the details below and reply with the MT103 or confirmation screenshot. We will put a hold on suspension for 48 hours pending receipt. Once treasury confirms funds, we'll mark INV-2026-927 as paid and apply any agreed credits."

leah (treasury): Operational note: if wire comes via an intermediary and fees are deducted, treasury will post the net amount. If they want Redwood to reimburse, require MT103 showing intermediary fees and we will issue a credit on next invoice up to the approved cap.

dave (finance): After funds post: set payment method to 'wire', run usage reconciliation, and create AR ticket if FX/fee variance >$50. Also update account notes and tag AML.

zoe (billing): Moving INV-2026-927 to "awaiting wire". I'll waive late fee once treasury confirms the transfer and AML sign-off if required. Tagging treasury & AML for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
